jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B https://juicebox.ai/blog/series-b here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.



About the Role

We’re hiring a GTM Strategy & Operations generalist to partner closely with our VP of Sales and GTM leadership team on the highest-impact growth initiatives across the business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on identifying, evaluating, and executing opportunities that accelerate revenue growth and improve go-to-market effectiveness. You'll work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Product to drive critical initiatives that shape how we acquire, monetize, and retain customers.

As one of the first GTM Strategy & Ops hires, you'll have outsized ownership and visibility, leading ambiguous, high-priority projects that influence company growth—from pricing and packaging strategy to AI-native workflows and new revenue opportunities.

You Will

 - Lead high-impact strategic initiatives across the GTM organization, from problem definition through execution

 - Partner with GTM leadership to identify growth opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive key business decisions

 - Analyze and recommend improvements to pricing, packaging, monetization, and go-to-market motions

 - Identify, size, and validate new markets, customer segments, and revenue opportunities

 - Drive special projects across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships that unlock growth and improve operational efficiency

 - Design and implement AI-native workflows that help GTM teams operate more effectively and scale faster

 - Build business cases, financial models, and analyses to support investment, resourcing, and prioritization decisions

 - Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that provide visibility into pipeline, conversion, retention, and overall GTM performance

 - Improve GTM processes, systems, and operating rhythms as the company scales

You Have

 - 3+ years of experience in Business Operations, Consulting, Investment Banking, or a similar generalist role (4+ years preferred)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems and drive them to resolution

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, or Finance teams

 - A strong interest in go-to-market strategy, revenue growth, and how businesses scale

 - Proficiency with spreadsheets, analytics tools, and data-driven decision making

 - Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across functions

 - A bias toward action and comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

Nice to Have

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, recruiting tech, or AI

 - Experience with AI tooling / have built your own tools

 - Experience as an early BizOps, Strategy, or first operations hire at a startup

Perks & Benefits for Full Time Employees

 - Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

 - Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

 - $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

About the Role

Customer Success at Juicebox sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, AI workflow enablement, and customer strategy. CSMs own the full customer relationship—from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal—while serving as trusted advisors and AI workflow experts.

Our customers range from enterprise talent teams to startup founders, staffing firms, and VC talent partners. As a PLG business, customers start small and scale quickly, so you'll often be managing onboarding, expansion, and renewal motions simultaneously.

You'll help define what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company shaping a new category. Our customers love the product, embrace innovation, and genuinely enjoy partnering with us. You'll do it alongside a low-ego, collaborative team and work directly with a VP of CS who has built world-class organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.



You Will…

 - Own a portfolio of customers and drive measurable outcomes across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

 - Lead customer success plans, align on key metrics, and ensure talent leaders realize value quickly.

 - Drive adoption of AI-native workflows, guide change management, and help customers reach their first “aha” moment and beyond.

 - Own commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing negotiations, and complex buying processes.

 - Identify and close expansion opportunities across teams, stakeholders, and product offerings.

 - Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with end users, champions, TA Ops leaders, and hiring managers.

 - Lead ROI discussions and QBRs that demonstrate impact and strengthen partnerships.

 - Help define and improve the Customer Success playbook by identifying gaps, solving problems, and scaling best practices.



You Have…

 - 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales with ownership of a revenue target and a portfolio of 75-150 accounts.

 - A track record of exceeding commercial goals and driving customer growth.

 - The ability to manage multiple customer conversations and priorities simultaneously.

 - A builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity before a playbook exists.

 - Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.

 - Experience in SaaS, consulting, HR tech, or talent tech; recruiting industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Perks & Benefits for Full Time Employees

 - Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

 - Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

jobs.description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B https://juicebox.ai/blog/series-b here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.



About the Role

We're building the Programs layer that turns great individual Customer Success work into a repeatable, scalable motion. This role sits at the intersection of customer education, community, and advocacy: three levers that drive adoption, expansion, and retention at scale. You'll be the first person dedicated to this at Juicebox, which means you're building from scratch with full ownership and a direct line to the VP of CS and leadership team.

You're building something that doesn't exist yet at a company growing 20% month over month. The programs you build will directly accelerate NRR, reduce CSM burden, and create a customer community around a product people genuinely love. You're building something that doesn't exist yet at a company growing 20% month over month. The programs you build will directly accelerate NRR, reduce CSM burden, and create a customer community around a product people genuinely love.

 - You Will
   
   - Onboarding and Time to Value: Design structured onboarding curricula (101/201/301-style progressions) that get new customers to first value fast and reduce dependency on 1:1 CSM time during ramp.
   
   - Self-Serve Education Infrastructure: Build in-product education, help content, playbooks, and guided workflows that let customers unblock themselves without opening a support ticket or waiting on a CSM.
   
   - Live Programs: Own and run recurring webinars, office hours, and cohort-based trainings async and in person that deepen adoption of core and advanced features, including agent workflows.
   
   - Content and Curriculum Ownership: Build a coherent content library and learning path, not disconnected assets, so customers always know what to learn next based on where they are in their journey.
   
   - AI-Enabled Content Scaling: Build a system, not a manual process, for keeping education content current against constant product changes. Use AI to detect when shipped features make existing docs, videos, or in-product guidance stale, and to accelerate first-draft content creation for new releases.
   
   - Certification: Design and run certification programs for customers and internal CSMs to standardize what "good" usage looks like and create a credential customers want to earn.
   
   - Measurement: Define and track education's impact on adoption, time to value, and retention, so this function operates with the same rigor as any other revenue-driving program, not as a soft cost center.
   
   - Education Tooling: Select, implement, and manage the LMS and supporting education stack, course authoring, video hosting, in-product guidance, and analytics, making build vs. buy calls as the program scales.
   
   - Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with CSMs to identify where education gaps are driving churn or dormancy risk, and with Product to feed education-driven customer feedback into roadmap priorities.

 - You Have
   
   - 4+ years in a Customer Education, CS Programs, Lifecycle, or Enablement role at a fast-growing company.
   
   - Experience building a customer education motion from scratch, not just inheriting or maintaining one.
   
   - Strong instincts for instructional design: you know how to break down complex product workflows into content that's simple, engaging, and drives action.
   
   - Experience using AI tools to scale content production and maintenance, ideally in a fast-shipping product environment.
   
   - Comfort with both live facilitation (webinars, training sessions, office hours) and asynchronous content (playbooks, in-product guides, documentation).
   
   - Experience evaluating or administering an LMS or customer education platform (e.g. Skilljar, Northpass, WorkRamp).
   
   - High energy with the ability to juggle many projects and conversations at once.
   
   - Love for working with and meeting with customers
   
   - Founder mentality: comfortable operating before the playbook exists, and comfortable operating independently without a lot of structure.
   
   - A point of view on what great customer education looks like, and a portfolio to back it up.

Perks & Benefits for Full Time Employees

 - Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own and scale our search acquisition engine across traditional and emerging search platforms. You'll take ownership of Google Ads while expanding our presence across Bing, OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads, and emerging AI-native advertising platforms. This role offers a rare opportunity to manage a meaningful budget, shape our search strategy from the ground up, and directly influence how we invest millions of dollars in customer acquisition.

You'll join a lean, high-impact marketing team where speed matters, experimentation is encouraged, and great ideas can quickly become reality.

We’re looking for builders who are motivated to elevate the GTM craft within one of the fastest growing AI companies. As our first Sales Leader in Europe, you’ll have a meaningful role in shaping our London team, culture, and how we grow in the region.

 - Lead and develop our growing team of Account Executives in London
